checks.name: subject listing over TLS
checks.detail: tapping a subject fetched the fixture feed over TLS and all three parsed papers rendered as rows

checks.name: abstract separates title, facts and prose
checks.detail: the first page shows the title, the byline, the categories, the journal reference and the comment as distinct elements above the paginated abstract

checks.name: downloading state then full text
checks.detail: the fixture's HTML fetched over TLS opened straight in the reader (the fetching state itself is unit-tested; the fixture answers within one drive step, too fast to film)

checks.name: listing shows the kept paper offline
checks.detail: after Keep for offline, the listing row carries the offline badge

checks.name: library shows reading progress
checks.detail: the kept row carries the size and a reading percentage recorded when the reader saved the place on the way out

checks.name: formulas, tables and figures survive
checks.detail: a paper with a displayed formula, a columnar table and a figure kept all three: the formula typeset from its LaTeX, the table read as rows and the figure fetched over TLS and drawn (panel shots arxiv-formula/-table/-figure)

checks.name: a failed figure fetch degrades to the caption
checks.detail: the figure the fixture 404s drew no error and no placeholder frame - the page reads the caption and the text after it (panel shot arxiv-figure-missing)

checks.name: kept reading survives a simulator restart
checks.detail: after the simulator process was killed and started again, the library still listed the kept paper at 74% and opening it landed on page 4 of 5, the place saved before the restart (panel shots arxiv-restart-library/-reopened)
